findings.description: The evidence_class vocabulary is not pinned as one closed set: F002 names terminal_transcript and contract_test, while F003 emits cli_transcript and contract_check, so captured agent evidence can fail the checker and close gate.
findings.recommendation: Define a single EvidenceClass enum/table in F001 and require every checker, adapter, and enforcement test to use those exact values.

findings.description: F004 adds required_data_sources to journeys but does not specify where evidence records structured data_source, availability, provenance, and capability_unavailable assertions, making keyed cross-surface comparison underspecified.
findings.recommendation: Add a structured evidence signal model or EvidenceRef fields for data_source key, availability, provenance, degradation mode, and skip reason.

findings.description: F001 allows consumer=both, but F005 only describes enforcement for journeys declaring consumer in {human, agent}, leaving the required per-family close-time proof for both ambiguous.
findings.recommendation: Normalize consumer=both into human and agent obligations, then add close-gate tests requiring one satisfying journey per family.

findings.description: The required_evidence_classes API collapses surface, consumer, and claim kind even though mutation and qualitative claims are not surface classes and may share a surface with read-only claims.
findings.recommendation: Make the rule key on surface_class, consumer family, and claim kind, with a deterministic matrix for read-only, interactive, mutation, qualitative, and agent contract cases.

findings.description: The contract says real-or-honestly-degraded data can prove readiness and F004 says honest degradation passes, but F005 requires at least one real non-seeded end-to-end journey, so degraded close behavior is unresolved.
findings.recommendation: Pin the close matrix cell for honest degradation: either count structured degraded capture as satisfying, or require explicit deferral/disposition when no real data exists.

findings.description: F005 relies on explicit non-goal deferral and operator disposition to allow close, but the plan does not define the structured fields or validation needed to distinguish them from ordinary prose.
findings.recommendation: Add a disposition/deferral schema keyed by objective claim and consumer family, with reason, operator marker, and tests proving only structured dispositions unblock close.

findings.description: F003 says typed-skip may use data_provenance=degraded or a skip marker, but F001 only permits seeded, real, or degraded, so the skip representation could violate the schema.
findings.recommendation: Represent typed-skip with allowed provenance plus explicit skip status and reason fields, not with a new data_provenance value.
